headline: A preprint reports safety retention from joint safety-and-utility mid-training
summary: A new arXiv paper adds to an existing line of alignment-oriented mid-training research. It trains a shared reasoning schema on safety and general prompts using model-generated structured documents and traces, then continues causal language-model training before SFT or RL. The authors report lower attack success and higher utility on Qwen3 through 8B and Llama-3.2 through 3B, with safety largely retained under later general-only SFT and GRPO. A Qwen3-4B ablation reports that direct SFT on the same generated reasoning data did not produce the same gain. Earlier Anthropic work also studies model-spec mid-training; a separate OpenAI report found limited transfer for a different alignment-document intervention after reasoning post-training. These are distinct author-run regimes, not a controlled comparison; none establishes broad transfer from this paper’s method.
